```sql
WITH region_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'North Centre Township'
    AND border_type ILIKE 'township'
    AND addr_state ILIKE 'Pennsylvania'
)
, clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM region_geom), true) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM region_geom))
)
, slope_raster AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF') AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT MAX(value) AS max_slope_degrees
FROM (
  SELECT (ST_DumpAsPolygons(rast)).*
  FROM slope_raster
) AS slope_values;
```
